First project-side materialization of the vulnerability-relevant table state. This WOFF directory read parses the `cmap` entry's tag, offset, compressed length, and uncompressed length from attacker bytes.

The fixing patch removes this per-call owner from `Font::ParseTable()` and instead creates `ots::Arena arena;` once in `ProcessGeneric()`, then passes that longer-lived owner into each `ParseTable()` call.
